claims.source_claim: Egyptians wanted to remain on Napoleon’s good side during his Egyptian campaign
claims.narration_span: En Egipto, para ganarse a Napoleón

claims.narration_span: y a batallas clave en Italia

claims.narration_span: Houdini tenía a Bobby, una mangosta

claims.source_claim: Houdini claimed it could supposedly identify fake money by attacking it
